## Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature or capability.

## Problem Statement / Motivation
What problem does this solve for riders, lessors, or operators? Why is this needed?

## Proposed Solution
Describe how the feature should work from the user's perspective and from the architectural perspective.

## Impact on Core Rules
Does this change impact:
- [ ] Payment rules or installment calculation (`README.md` Section 8)
- [ ] Lease lifecycle states or transitions (`README.md` Section 6)
- [ ] Lock safety rules or immobilization triggers (`README.md` Section 11)
- [ ] Smart contract interfaces (`README.md` Section 7)
- [ ] None of the above

*Note: Changes affecting core rules require an ADR in `docs/decisions/` prior to implementation.*

## Alternatives Considered
What other approaches or designs did you consider?

## Additional Context
Add any other diagrams, mockups, or context here.
